locations.name: Rock House
locations.description: Rockhouse offers a variety of tasty sandwiches and plates, all priced at $12. Their sandwiches come on homemade or Jalapeno Cheese buns and include options like Chicken Fried Chicken, Honey Fried Chicken with or without pimento, Chicken Fried Steak, Grilled Chicken, Pulled Pork, and even Grilled Cheese for $10. Each sandwich comes with your choice of one side. For plates, you get to choose two sides, and the options include Chicken Fried Chicken, Chicken Fried Steak, Chicken Strips, and Grilled Chicken. They also have nachos for $15 where you pick your chips or fries with nacho cheese, your meat (like chicken fried chicken, grilled chicken, pulled pork, chicken fried steak, or ground beef), and your toppings such as lettuce, tomato, onions, jalapenos, and pinto beans. Sides are $3 each, with choices like crack green beans, homemade pinto beans, fries, fried okra, potato salad, coleslaw, and fried green beans (which cost $2 extra). Drinks come in 20oz for $3 or 32oz for $5, with free refills on tea only. They have sweet and unsweet tea, sweet peach tea, Coke products, Sprite, Dr. Pepper, and water for $2. They also offer a specialty item called the walking taco where you pick your chips (Fritos or Doritos), meat (ground beef or grilled chicken), and toppings like nacho cheese, lettuce, tomato, onions, jalapenos, pinto beans, and sour cream. If you want to check out more about Rockhouse, you can find them on the First Monday Finder Map by searching "Rockhouse."

locations.name: Tasty Treats
locations.description: Looking for the best food at First Monday Trade Days in Canton, Texas? Tasty Treats Café is a go-to Canton TX food vendor serving up crowd-favorite fair food, Tex-Mex, and classic comfort meals right in the heart of the market. Enjoy hot, fresh favorites like tacos, nachos, Frito pie, chili cheese fries, and chicken or beef fajita wraps, plus hearty options like loaded baked potatoes, BBQ sandwiches, French dip, and chicken salad croissants. Need something quick? Grab a corn dog, hot dog, or sandwich with chips and get back to shopping. Cool off with Blue Bell ice cream, cold drinks, lemonade, or sweet tea, making it one of the top spots for dessert and drinks at First Monday. Whether you’re hunting for antiques or exploring vendors, Tasty Treats Café is a must-stop for lunch, snacks, and comfort food in Canton TX.
